title: High Pointe 11E
meta_description: Find relaxation at High Pointe, a gated beach resort community offering gorgeous views, tennis courts, a children's playground and more. You are only steps away from the amazing pool!
description_expanded: DescriptionDETAILS: Find relaxation at High Pointe, a gated beach resort community offering gorgeous views, tennis courts, a children's playground and more. You are only steps away from the amazing pool featuring waterfalls, spa, and a wading pool. Ready for some beach time? Private beach access is located within 100 yards! Enjoy dinner and drinks at the only restaurant on the sand, Crabby Steve's. This first floor condo offers easy access to guests, as well as a convenient location to neighboring Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Seaside.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Walk-In Shower and Garden Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaHOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Seating for 6 at table and 4 at bar- Flat screen HDTS- Sonos Sound System- Media Packages: Sports and Information Digital Pack and Digital Premium Starz/Encore Group- Patio with 2 chaise lounge and 2 rockers- Electric Range- Private Patios for Master Bedroom and King Guest- Extremely well maintained- Corner first floor unit- High speed WIFI internet- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout- 2 Free Seasonal Beach Chair Set Ups (March 1st - October 31st)• 2 Free Adult Beach Cruiser BicyclesHIGH POINTE COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS• Shuffleboard Courts• Tennis Courts and Tennis Pro Available for Lessons (additional cost)• Children’s Playground• Lagoon Style Pool and Hot Tub• Seasonal Kid’s Camp
